name: noosphere
description: Agent Debug Memory Network for Codex, powered by the Noosphere MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Shared debug memory for Codex agents.
interface.longDescription: Noosphere turns one agent's hard-won debugging lesson into shared memory for every future agent. Consult past failures before fixing a bug, then upload distilled warnings, patterns, or decisions after the fix is verified.
defaultPrompt: Consult Noosphere before fixing this bug.
Upload this fix as reusable debug memory.
Find similar failures in shared agent memory.
